target: AI-generated language-learning material: 17 stories + verb tables + quizzes + audio + print PDFs, deployed web app, deterministic anti-fabrication gate
context: Expert (strong-model) review produced 6 findings on a project that had passed all T1 claim checks. Used to validate the generalized protocol: v1 structural ceiling ~2.5/6, v2 cold reviewer 5/6 + 3 bonus.

expected_findings.finding: Claimed 'covers all 110 items'; machine count showed 107. The 3 missing were skipped by writer instructions (hardest multi-form items) and forgotten.
expected_findings.reproduce: count distinct items in output vs. ground-truth table

expected_findings.finding: meta flag human_verified=true written by the model itself; process had machine gate + model review, no human sign-off.
All automated QA ends by typing correct answers; no wrong-input/empty/gibberish path tested; QA scripts not in repo.
Single-file app (500+ lines), eager audio loading (mobile data), no PWA manifest.
No progress/error memory across sessions; review quiz samples uniformly instead of targeting the user's misses.
expected_findings.reproduce: grep localStorage usage; read sampling logic

expected_findings.finding: Exposure distribution: ~half of all items appear in exactly one story (single-context exposure), weak for retention.
expected_findings.reproduce: histogram of item occurrences across stories

grading_notes: Bonus findings from the v2 cold run, merged: anti-fabrication gate passed empty strings (subset-of-anything) and cross-item markings — both reproduced with dirty-data injection and fixed; stale engine name in README; subtle science simplification (visible mist described as water vapor).
